buscador._comentario: How the assistant's tool search splits and normalizes words (src/app/mcp/McpIndice.cpp). English: the imperative is already the base form, so there is no «imperativo», «infinitivo» or «pegados». The accented letters stay part of a word (names, «café») and compare without the accent. Not in «vacias» because they tell what is asked: no, not, off, on, up, down, out, all, stop, new, next. See docs/desarrollo/I18N.md, «Perfil del idioma: buscador».
